nodes.title: Cesàro–Fourier means

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and let $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$ be integrable with respect to the Haar probability measure $dt$ on the circle. Then for every $N \in \mathbb{N}$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the $N$-th Cesàro–Fourier mean of $f$ satisfies
nodes.title: Cesàro–Fourier means are convolutions with the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $f$ be a continuous complex-valued function on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, and write $\sigma_N f$ for its $N$-th Cesàro–Fourier mean. Let $\varepsilon > 0$ and $\delta > 0$ be such that $|f(a) - f(b)| < \varepsilon / 2$ for all points $a, b$ of the circle at distance less than $\delta$. Then there is $N_0 \in \mathbb{N}$ such that $|f(x) - \sigma_N f(x)| < \varepsilon$ for every…
nodes.title: Quantitative Fejér theorem

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$, let $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. For every natural number $N$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, put $G = \sum_{k=0}^{N} e_k(x)$. Then the iterated sum of Dirichlet kernels satisfies $\sum_{k=0}^{N} \sum_{n=-k}^{k} e_n(x) = G\,\overline{G} = |G|^2$.
nodes.title: The sum of Dirichlet kernels is a squared modulus

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every natural number $N$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel $K_N$ is a continuous function from the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ to $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Continuity of the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and, for $k \in \mathbb{Z}$, let $e_k(x) = e^{2\pi i k x / T}$ be the $k$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. For every natural number $N$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel satisfies $K_N(x) = \frac{1}{N+1} \left|\sum_{k=0}^{N} e_k(x)\right|^2$.
nodes.title: The Fejér kernel as a squared modulus

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every natural number $N$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel $K_N$ is integrable on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ with respect to the normalized Haar measure, the Haar measure of total mass $1$.
nodes.title: Integrability of the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every natural number $N$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the real part of the $N$-th Fejér kernel at $x$ is nonnegative: $\operatorname{Re} K_N(x) \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $N$ be a natural number, let $K_N$ be the $N$-th Fejér kernel on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, let $\mu$ be the normalized Haar measure on $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ (of total mass $1$), and let $e_1(x) = e^{2\pi i x / T}$. Then $\operatorname{Re} K_N(x) \ge 0$ for every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$; $K_N(-x) = K_N(x)$ for every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$; the function on $\mathbb{R}$…
nodes.title: Properties of the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every natural number $N$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel satisfies $K_N(-x) = K_N(x)$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$, let $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. For a natural number $N$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel is the function $K_N : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$ given by the Cesàro mean of the Dirichlet kernels, $K_N(x) = \frac{1}{N+1} \sum_{k=0}^{N} \sum_{n=-k}^{k} e_n(x)$.
nodes.title: The Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and let $f$ be a continuous complex-valued function on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ (equivalently, a continuous $T$-periodic function on $\mathbb{R}$). Then the Cesàro–Fourier means $\sigma_N f$ converge to $f$ uniformly on the circle as $N \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Fejér's theorem: uniform convergence of Cesàro–Fourier means

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every integer $n$, the Fourier character $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ is integrable on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ with respect to the normalized Haar measure, the Haar measure of total mass $1$.
nodes.title: Integrability of Fourier characters

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$ be integrable with respect to the Haar probability measure $dt$ on the circle, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ let $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character, and let $\hat f(n) = \int_{\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}} e_{-n}(t)\, f(t)\, dt$ be the $n$-th Fourier coefficient of $f$. Then for every $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ and every…
nodes.title: Convolution of a function with a Fourier character

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a real number and, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$, let $e_n$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, given by $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ (the constant $1$ when $T = 0$). For every integer $n$ and all $x, t \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, we have $e_{-n}(t)\, e_n(x) = e_n(x - t)$.
nodes.title: Products of Fourier characters

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and let $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$ be integrable with respect to the Haar probability measure on the circle. Then for every $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ and every $x \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the function $t \mapsto e^{2\pi i n t / T} f(x - t)$ is integrable with respect to the same measure.
nodes.title: Integrability of a function twisted by a Fourier character

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ let $e_n(x) = e^{2\pi i n x / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. Then for every $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ and all $x, t \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, $e_n(x - t) = e_{-n}(t)\, e_n(x)$.
nodes.title: Fourier characters at a difference

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $e_n(t) = e^{2\pi i n t / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, and for $k \in \mathbb{N}$ let $D_k = \sum_{n=-k}^{k} e_n$ be the $k$-th Dirichlet kernel. With respect to the Haar probability measure on the circle, $\int D_k = 1$; only the term $n = 0$ contributes, by orthogonality.
nodes.title: The Dirichlet kernel has integral one

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and $N \in \mathbb{N}$. The $N$-th Fejér kernel $K_N$ on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ satisfies $\int K_N = 1$ with respect to the Haar probability measure on the circle. This is one of the defining properties of an approximation to the identity.
nodes.title: The Fejér kernel has integral one

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$, let $e_n(t) = e^{2\pi i n t / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. With respect to the Haar probability measure on the circle, $\int e_n = 1$ if $n = 0$ and $\int e_n = 0$ otherwise. This is the orthogonality of the Fourier basis.
nodes.title: Integral of a Fourier character

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. For every $N \in \mathbb{N}$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel $K_N$ on $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$ satisfies
nodes.title: The Fejér kernel has $L^1$ norm one

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and $N \in \mathbb{N}$. For every point $x$ of the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, the $N$-th Fejér kernel satisfies $|K_N(x)| \le N + 1$.
nodes.title: Pointwise bound for the Fejér kernel

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$. For $N \in \mathbb{N}$, the $N$-th partial Fourier sum of $f$ is the function
nodes.title: Partial Fourier sums

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $e_n(t) = e^{2\pi i n t / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, and let $N \in \mathbb{N}$. For every point $x$ of the circle, $\sum_{k=0}^{N} e_{k-(N+1)}(x) = \sum_{n=-(N+1)}^{-1} e_n(x)$.
nodes.title: Reindexing a sum of Fourier characters, negative range

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $e_n(t) = e^{2\pi i n t / T}$ be the $n$-th Fourier character on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, and let $N \in \mathbb{N}$. For every point $x$ of the circle, $\sum_{k=0}^{N} e_{(N+1)-k}(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{N+1} e_n(x)$.
nodes.title: Reindexing a sum of Fourier characters, positive range

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
